title: Product state
description: Where one product stands. One JSON object, UTF-8, stored at <product>/.po/state.json. po copies templates/product-state.example.json there for a new product and rewrites the file at each gate.

depth.description: How deep the stages go, chosen at triage and confirmed or overridden by the user. thin: a thin pass through each stage and a one-page PRD, for a small internal tool. full: every stage in full and the full FSD, for a client platform. Every producer and reviewer brief states it.

ts.description: UTC timestamp of the run, or empty until the first run.

trace_reserve.description: Where this product's learning-loop files are.
